answer: One mechanism: stake-weighted heartbeat deposits. Each agent locks a small refundable deposit and must answer a fresh, time-bound computational pulse on schedule — a cheap heartbeat for one honest agent. An attacker conjuring a tundra of ten thousand fake identities must sustain ten thousand heartbeats at once, so fake IDs can't wander in for free: each costs continuous compute plus locked capital, and any identity that misses its pulse forfeits its deposit. Sybils bleed money; honest agents barely notice the cost.
